body.p: The various parts of the Office Action (and other matters, if any) are discussed below under appropriate headings.

Applicant appreciates the Examiner's acknowledgment that claims 1-4, 8, 11, and 16 are allowed though claims 2 and 8 are objected to and that claims 5, 6, 9, 10, and 12-15 would be allowable once the 35 U.S.C.§ 112(b) rejection is addressed.
Claims 2 and 8 have been objected to because of informalities. The claims have been amended to address the informalities. Withdrawal of the objection is respectfully requested.

Claims 5, 6, 9, 10, and 12-15 stand rejected as indefinite. Claim 5 has been amended to depend from claim 4 to overcome the rejection. Claim 6 has been amended to clarify that "amplitude value/s" constitutes "one or more amplitude values" to overcome the rejection. Claim 9 has been amended to clarify the periodic duration to overcome the rejection. Claims 10 and 12 have each been amended into independent form by incorporating the features of claim 1 and further to clarify the structure of the anesthetizing monitoring unit. Claim 15 has been amended to clarify the thresholds based on antecedent basis to overcome the rejection. The remaining claim rejections are for dependency from a rejected base claim and are overcome for the reasons above. Accordingly, Applicant requests withdrawal of the indefiniteness rejection.
Claims 10 and 12-14 stand rejected as being of improper dependent form. As noted above, claims 10 and 12 have each been amended into independent form and therefore
overcome the rejection. Accordingly, Applicant requests withdrawal of the improper dependent form rejection.

In view of the foregoing, Applicant requests issuance of a notice of allowance. Should the Examiner feel that a telephone interview would be helpful to facilitate favorable prosecution of the above-identified application, the undersigned invites the Examiner to contact the undersigned at the telephone number provided below.

The absence in this reply of any comments on any contentions set forth in the Office Action should not be construed to be an acquiescence therein. Rather, no comment is needed since the rejections should be withdrawn for at least the foregoing reasons.
